response.sql: WITH event_budget_avg AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS per_event_avg FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(per_event_avg) AS overall_average FROM event_budget_avg), above_average_events AS (SELECT eba.event_name, eba.per_event_avg FROM event_budget_avg eba CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE eba.per_event_avg > oa.overall_average), kept_event_avg AS (SELECT AVG(per_event_avg) AS kept_average FROM above_average_events) SELECT aae.event_name, aae.per_event_avg, aae.per_event_avg - oa.overall_average, aae.per_event_avg / kea.kept_average FROM above_average_events aae CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN kept_event_avg kea ORDER BY aae.event_name;
